column2:

unconscious, though.

I visited you in the hospital. You were still

column2: Huh. Then you must have seen me naked.

column2:

bandages and tubes, so I couldn't do
anything but look.

column2: Better luck next time.

column2: Let's hope so...

column2:

that until just yesterday. In fact, you really
shouldn't even be on this mission.

to nag.

don't know when to keep your mouth shut.

going to lose your medical license if this
mission fails.

column2:
Yes, there was talk of that, but the mission
won't fail, WILL it?
column3:

column2: Of course not.
column3: Of course not.

column2:

what? I really don't care about my medical
license.
column3:

column2:
Didn't they use that to force you to
participate in this operation?

Didn't they use that to force you to

column2: No. I volunteered.

column2: Why?
column3: Why?

column2: So that I could watch over you.
column3: So that I could watch over you.

column2:
Snake, you're the best agent I've ever seen.
But you push yourself too hard. You're
reckless.
column3:

column2:
Someone has to stop you from getting into
trouble... to make sure you and The Boss
don't kill each other.

column2:
So that's why I volunteered. I mean, you
couldn't ask for a better guardian angel
than me, right?
column3:

couldn't ask for a better guardian angel

column2: ...Thanks.
column3: ...Thanks.

column2: Stop right there!
column3: Stop right there!

column2: You can thank me when you get back.
column3: You can thank me when you get back.

column2: All right.
column3: All right.

column2: Para-Medic...
column3: Para-Medic...

column2:
Snake! Je suis si heureuse de t'entendre à
nouveau.
column3:
Snake! Je suis si heureuse de t'entendre à
nouveau.

column2: Moi aussi. Ça fait une semaine, non?
column3: Moi aussi. Ça fait une semaine, non?

column2: En fait, quatre jours.
column3: En fait, quatre jours.

column2:
Je t'ai rendu visite à l'hôpital. Mais tu étais
encore inconscient.
column3:
Je t'ai rendu visite à l'hôpital. Mais tu étais

column2: Hein. Alors tu as dû me voir tout nu?

et de tubes, alors je n'ai pu que te regarder.

column2: Ça sera mieux la prochaine fois.

column3: Espérons...

ne devrais même pas participer à cette
mission.

vu. Mais tu te surmènes trop. Tu es trop
téméraire.
